name: Decision Gate
description: Provides one bounded decision tool backed by a lazy local decision model. The model is never used for final architecture, root-cause, merge, or blocker decisions.

decision_credential.label: Decision Gate server token
decision_credential.description: Bearer token accepted by the Decision Gate MCP server.

hooks.name: Decision
hooks.description: Make one small, bounded, closed-option judgment. Use for relevance filtering, routing, triage, retry/skip choices, taxonomy, or candidate prioritization. Treat the result and confidence as evidence, never as truth. Do not use for root-cause conclusions, architectural correctness, final merge/blocker decisions, or destructive actions.

state.description: Only the concise evidence needed for this bounded judgment.

question.description: One narrow question with an explicit candidate set.

options.description: Option ids mapped to short descriptions; keep the set mutually understandable and small.
